topic: No traces from any service, infra metrics fine
environment: Several instrumented services in other containers
symptom_pattern: After an Agent configuration change, no traces arrive from any service, while host and container metrics from the same Agent look normal.
root_cause: DD_APM_NON_LOCAL_TRAFFIC was set to false, so the trace-agent only accepts connections from localhost and every app container is refused.
resolution_path: Check agent status APM section (receiver stats empty)
Look at tracer errors (connection refused to the Agent)

qa_pairs.tse_question: What does the APM section of agent status show?

qa_pairs.customer_answer: We merged a 'secure defaults' env file into the Agent; it has a bunch of *_NON_LOCAL_TRAFFIC=false lines.

customer_style.tone: technical lead, structured, expects a root cause
